strong    both arms n >= 500 and the 95% CI of the difference excludes 0
  moderate  both arms n >= 100 and the CI excludes 0
  weak      direction only (small n or CI includes 0)
  informed_guess  no direct data; reasoning stated in `note`

records.note: Every past call used one female voice ('Payal'), so the data cannot compare genders. We default to a warm female voice (matches the proven baseline) and use a measured male voice only for formal large-company personas, as a deliberate, low-confidence choice to be A/B tested.

Bot spoke Hindi/Hinglish only. EV-08* shows how those regions convert on Hindi; offering the regional language is an informed guess, so we start in Hinglish/English and switch only when the seller does.
Bulbul pace can only be set per persona; past calls had nearly constant pace, so slowing down on confusion relies on EV-26 (rephrase) and EV-29b (repeat) plus standard call-centre practice.
